title: Join Stamford University Bangladesh as Lecturer
summary: Joined the Department of Computer Science & Engineering as a Lecturer, teaching undergraduate courses and supporting student learning through practical instruction, projects, and academic activities.
details: Joined the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) at Stamford University Bangladesh as a Lecturer. Teaching undergraduate courses totaling 30 credits, developing course materials, assessments, and hands-on laboratory activities aligned with Outcome-Based Education (OBE) objectives. Mentoring future computer scientists and supervising academic development.

title: Join BUET as Research Assistant
summary: Joined a UGC-ICSETEP Research & Development Grant project on Graph Machine Learning and Networks, working on GNN–LLM integration and patient-specific clinical deterioration pathway discovery from longitudinal ICU data.
details: Commenced work under the UGC-ICSETEP Research and Development Grant (RDG) project at BUET CSE under the supervision of Dr. Sadia Sharmin and Dr. Atif Hasan Rahman. Conducting research on Graph Machine Learning and Networks, focusing on GNN–LLM integration and patient-specific clinical deterioration pathway discovery from irregular longitudinal ICU data using multimodal continuous-time event graphs.

title: IEEE WIE Big Idea Pitch Competition - Winner
summary: Selected as the Best Transformative Business Idea Pitch winner, receiving a $1,000 award for an innovative AI-driven solution addressing a real-world challenge.
details: Awarded Champion and Best Transformative Business Idea Pitch at the global IEEE WIE Big Idea Pitch Competition 2026, receiving a USD 1,000 grant prize for PinkLifeLine's AI-driven early breast cancer risk prediction framework.
